{
  "name": "plan-limits",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "description": "Your plan's 5-hour and weekly usage above the prompt, with the time left until each resets.",
  "author": {
    "name": "Santiago Sosa",
    "url": "https://github.com/santtisosa"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/santtisosa/plan-limits",
  "repository": "https://github.com/santtisosa/plan-limits",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "claude-code",
    "mod",
    "claude-code-mods"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "placement": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Placement",
      "description": "hint: dim text at the end of the hint line under the prompt. band: a colored row above the prompt. status: a pinned notice under the prompt.",
      "default": "hint",
      "options": [
        "hint",
        "band",
        "status"
      ]
    },
    "okColor": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Normal color",
      "description": "Bar color while usage is comfortable.",
      "default": "green",
      "options": [
        "green",
        "yellow",
        "red",
        "cyan",
        "blue",
        "magenta",
        "white",
        "gray"
      ]
    },
    "warnColor": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Warning color",
      "description": "Bar color from 70% used, or when the pace points past 85%.",
      "default": "yellow",
      "options": [
        "green",
        "yellow",
        "red",
        "cyan",
        "blue",
        "magenta",
        "white",
        "gray"
      ]
    },
    "hotColor": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Critical color",
      "description": "Bar color from 90% used, or when the pace runs out before the reset.",
      "default": "red",
      "options": [
        "green",
        "yellow",
        "red",
        "cyan",
        "blue",
        "magenta",
        "white",
        "gray"
      ]
    },
    "barWidth": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Bar width",
      "description": "How many cells each bar has.",
      "default": 5
    }
  }
}
